mapper.select: SELECT command_id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, operation, payload_sha256, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, dispatched_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, status_updated_at, version, NULL::text AS organization_path FROM device_command_request WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT request.command_id, request.tenant_id, request.organization_id, request.device_id, request.requested_by, request.idempotency_key, request.operation, request.payload_sha256, request.status, request.failure_code, request.requested_at, request.expires_at, request.dispatched_at, request.acknowledged_at, request.completed_at, request.status_updated_at, request.version, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device_command_request request JOIN organization ON organization.id = request.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = request.tenant_id WHERE request.command_id = #{commandId}

SELECT command_id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, operation, payload_sha256, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, dispatched_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, status_updated_at, version, NULL::text AS organization_path FROM device_command_request WHERE command_id = #{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_command_request(command_id, tenant_id, organization_id, device_id, requested_by, idempotency_key, operation, payload_sha256, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, dispatched_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, status_updated_at, version) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{tenantId}, #{organizationId}, #{deviceId}, #{requestedBy}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operation}, #{payloadSha256}, #{status}, #{failureCode}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{dispatchedAt}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{statusUpdatedAt}, #{version})

INSERT INTO integration_outbox(id, tenant_id, topic, partition_key, event_type, payload, status, attempts, available_at, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{topic}, #{partitionKey}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), 'PENDING', 0, #{occurredAt}, #{occurredAt})
INSERT INTO device_command_status_inbox(tenant_id, event_id, command_id, received_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{commandId}, #{receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, event_id) DO NOTHING
